messages:
jules: Moving next month, giving away a few office things. Free pickup (first come). Pics here: https://imgur.com/a/abcd123

Items:
- Herman Miller Aeron (Size B) — gently used, mesh, lumbar support. Slightly low gas lift (holds fine).
- Ergotron LX Dual Monitor Arm — VESA 75/100, includes screws.
- Thick anti-fatigue standing mat — 48x24, some scuffs but no tears.
- USB-C 2-port KVM switch + HDMI cable (works with Mac/Linux).
- Philips Hue Lightstrip (2m) — nearly new.

Pickup: SoMa (3rd St & Folsom). Open pickup window: Sat 10:00–14:00 or weekdays after 18:00. DM me to claim. Can deliver within ~5 miles for $20.

sam: Interested in the Aeron. Is the seat fabric or mesh? Any rips?

jules: mesh, no rips. Seat width ~20" (50cm). Tag photo: https://imgur.com/a/seat-tag

maria: Ooh the mat, would love that. Can I snag it Saturday at noon?

jules: Maria — yep, i’ll hold it until 11:00 for someone then until 12:00 for you. DM me to confirm.

alex: I’ll take the KVM + HDMI. Can swing by Sat.

taylor: Can the arm support two 27" 4K monitors (about 7kg each)?

jules: Ergotron spec: up to ~9kg per arm. I ran two 27" 4Ks on it without issues (light bezels).

ops-bot: Reminder — please don't post personal addresses in public channels. Use DMs for exact meetup details. :lock:

chris: I can help carry the Aeron if needed. Happy to meet at 10:30.

maria: Confirmed for the mat at 12:00. Thanks!

jules: All claimed for now: Aeron -> sam (chris helping), mat -> maria, KVM -> alex, arm -> taylor (tentative). If anything changes I’ll update here. Thanks :raised_hands:

sam: Sending $30 Venmo for the Aeron gas fix — @sam (chair note)

alex: Venmo sent $5 for cables. :money_with_wings:

taylor: Can I drop by at ~9:45 before the mat pickup to test the arm quickly? Won't be long.

jules: Sure, see you then.
